checks.name: Actual settings popup renders named controls
Loaded appearance is current, not an unsaved draft
Current theme and scale exposed semantically
End reaches refresh and skips disabled Save
Guidance is readable text rather than disabled controls
Keyboard theme dispatch uses exact current identity once
Dispatch alone cannot optimistically apply theme
Committed text size applies to real rendering
Dawn colors apply to actual document
Enlarged small viewport reveals last control
Escape submits dismissal after real key release
Forced color content and focus remain readable
Invalid presentation scale cannot change appearance
Dismissed help keeps a keyboard reachable reopening control
Help Enter emits one current scoped action
Reopening help retains the same focused identity and reveals it
Help does not trap preference navigation
